title: On Regretting the words the next morning
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：regret　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 regret 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the keeper ① regretted the words the next morning in public, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② regrets the words the next morning in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ regret the words the next morning at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ regretted the words the next morning before — a line in the calendar for January 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Regretting the words the next morning in public, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ regret that nothing more could be done in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Regret that nothing more could be done at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ regrets that nothing more could be done in public every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ regretted the words the next morning again when nobody else would.

⑩ To regret the words the next morning, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody regrets the words the next morning in silence again and somebody must regret the words the next morning in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 后悔（一般过去式 regretted the words the next morning：1979 年守夜人头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 后悔（一般现在 regrets the words the next morning：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 后悔（不定式 to regret the words the next morning：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 后悔（过去完成时 had regretted the words the next morning：1973 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 后悔（动名词 regretting the words the next morning 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 婉言（regret that nothing more could be done：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去婉言很遗憾再没有什么可做的）
G. v. 婉言（regret that nothing more could be done：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 后悔（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 regrets that nothing more could be done，而母亲又一次 regretted the words the next morning）

items.q: regretted the words the next morning
regrets the words the next morning
to regret the words the next morning
regretted the words the next morning before
regretting the words the next morning
regret that nothing more could be done in silence
regret that nothing more could be done at once
regrets that nothing more could be done in public
regretted the words the next morning again
to regret the words the next morning

answers.why: regret 意为“后悔”，1979 年守夜人当着众人面后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 regretted。
regret 意为“后悔”，自那以后守夜人一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 regrets。
regret 意为“后悔”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔”，此处为不定式 to regret the words the next morning。
regret 意为“后悔”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1986 年之前就有人后悔过，故用过去完成时 had regretted。
regret 意为“后悔”，守夜人说“后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 regretting the words the next morning 作主语。
regret 意为“婉言”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去婉言很遗憾再没有什么可做的”，should ever 之后用原形 regret that nothing more could be done。
regret 意为“婉言”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻婉言很遗憾再没有什么可做的（regret that nothing more could be done at once），以后再也不要提起。
regret 意为“后悔”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例婉言很遗憾再没有什么可做的，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 regrets。
regret 意为“后悔”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔，用一般过去式 regretted 叙述。
regret 意为“后悔”，结尾那句是母亲 1991 年的话：要后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，守夜人当着众人面后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔；钟楼里每一个过路人都说这是头一回。（regretted the words the next morning）
多年以后，守夜人仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（regrets the words the next morning）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔这件事本身。（to regret the words the next morning）
早在 1973 年就有人后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔，一月那天年历上的一行字就是证据。（had regretted the words the next morning）
守夜人说过，当着众人面后悔第二天早上就为那句话后悔这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（regretting the words the next morning 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻婉言很遗憾再没有什么可做的，以后再也不要提起。（regret that nothing more could be done，祈使句）
answers: In 1979 the keeper regretted the words the next morning in public, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the keeper still regrets the words the next morning in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to regret the words the next morning at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had regretted the words the next morning long before 1986, and the line in the calendar for January proves it.
Regretting the words the next morning in public, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Regret that nothing more could be done at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 regret 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the keeper regretted the words the next morning in public, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper regrets the words the next morning in silence whenever the tower asks.
Regretting the words the next morning in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever regret that nothing more could be done in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower regrets that nothing more could be done in public every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother regretted the words the next morning again, and the tower remembered that half.
